reveal.terms: "Indexing" means writing a name in filing order: surname first, then given name, then middle initial. A title such as Dr. is the last unit.
reveal.shortcut: Rewrite each surname as one block: drop spaces and hyphens, keep the prefix (Dela Cruz = DELACRUZ). Then compare letter by letter (ARMA Rule 1). Order: Dr. Mario R. De Guzman → DEGUZMAN, Mario; Benito E. Flores → FLORES, Benito; Atty. Ernesto N. Lopez → LOPEZ, Ernesto; Lourdes T. Villanueva → VILLANUEVA, Lourdes.
reveal.why_correct: "Lourdes T. Villanueva" is right. It comes last when every name is indexed surname first, letter by letter. This follows the standard office filing rule (ARMA International Simplified Filing Standard Rules, Rule 6), not a rule published by the CSC.

why_wrong.o2: "Benito E. Flores" files as FLORES, which comes before VILLANUEVA.
why_wrong.o3: "Atty. Ernesto N. Lopez" sorts by the title (Dr., Atty., Engr.). A title is only the last unit.
why_wrong.o4: "Dr. Mario R. De Guzman" sorts by the given name. Personal names file by surname first.
